interiorsStandard: a building that reads as enterable from the street IS enterable: its door is a #119 host, its inside holds who #93 puts there at that hour, its closed hours are a #297-contract gate with an in-world reason on the door. Exceptions authored singly (a #154 sealed wing; a private door somebody answers — #301's smallest conversation). The art makes the promise; breaking it is a shipping defect

presenceRead.behaviour: #152's wild vocabulary lived in the open (graze, drink, patrol, startle, flee, threaten, ignore), bent by #67 weather/phase. presenceRead.derivation: read-time, from the area's #7 stock x each species' #152 wild view x live world state (#19 phase, #61/#67 weather, #142 climate) — #231's derivation family at individual scale
presenceRead.encounterMath: UNMOVED: meeting a roamer routes into #7/#52/#110/#209 as they stand. Visibility changes how a meeting begins, never what a meeting is
presenceRead.roamer: a PRESENCE, not a #80 individual: species, behaviour state, position-in-the-moment. It becomes an individual only when a real system takes hold (encounter roll, capture) — generation at the moment of contact, never wholesale in the fields

showMirror: the world's aliveness is the show's default background: #215 beds + #152's show view are the same derivation, drawn instead of computed. Camera and Ranger stand in one world; neither may find it empty
